title: yodel lint --rules --json
description: Version 1. Every lint rule, with the level yodel.config.ts sets for it in this project. Within a version, fields are only added; a reader ignores fields it does not know.

silenceable.description: A -- yodel:allow <id> <reason> line can silence it for one statement.

configurable.description: yodel.config.ts lint.rules may change its level.

dialect.description: The dialect it applies to; both when absent.

schema.description: One of the sql lexicon's schema checks, run on each migration's recorded schema.
